# H6008 — Wi-Fi provisioning over the encoded link, docs/protocol/ble.md 4.
# Captured 2026-09-13, ble firmware 1.01.25. The unit was already on a network
# and bound to an account; it accepted the transfer and joined the new network.
#
# Each line is one write on the write characteristic of 1.1 and, where the
# device answered, the notification on the notify characteristic. The frames
# below are the plaintext; the transport encodes each one under the session
# seed of 9 before it reaches the air. The XOR checksum is on the plaintext.
#
# The four data packets of the transfer are NOT recorded here: they carry the
# network name and the network password in the clear, and no substitute of the
# same length exists for a password. The header states the count, so what the
# packets carried is `04` packets of 16 bytes. See
# tests/fixtures/golden/ble/H6008.json for the same transfer built from
# placeholder credentials.
#
# --- which endpoint the device asks for ---
> aa ab 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01
< aa ab 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 03
# type 2, so the transfer carries `https://device.govee.com`; the second byte
# is the hidden-network flag, and this unit does not ask for it.
#
# --- wake the Wi-Fi module, then wait 3 s ---
> 33 17 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 25
# No answer, and none is due: the phone controller writes this one and reads
# nothing back.
#
# --- the transfer, 300 ms between frames ---
> a1 11 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 b4
# (four data packets, omitted — see the note above)
> a1 11 ff 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 4f
< a1 11 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 b0
# Status 0: accepted. The same transfer paced at 25 ms between frames drew no
# answer at all, and the unit stayed off the network.
#
# --- release the module ---
> 33 17 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 24
